Team settings

team-x

Changes the name people see. Its agents, tasks, history and links stay the same.

Workflow instructions

Choose the instructions captured on tasks when they are first claimed. Preset edits are local to this team.

Team working mode

Working mode instructions are saved with each task on its first claim. Existing claimed tasks keep their instructions. This setting provides guidance; it does not create worktrees automatically. Docs: Team working modes

Cross-team messaging is off by default. Both teams must allow it. Only Orchestrators and the Operator can send; received messages are requests, not instructions.

Off by default. Files shared with other teams are not scanned, and artifact bytes are not redacted.
